name: pulse-tree-view
description: Native VS Code sidebar Tree View for this device's git-pulse / rebalance-OS activity — Today, Yesterday, Upcoming Meetings, and Assigned Issues read straight from the local pulse markdown file. No pulse-server dependency, no Python venv required.

pulseTreeView.pulseFilePath.description: Absolute path (or ~-relative) to the rendered pulse markdown file to display, e.g. ~/git-pulse-sync/live-pulse.md. This must be the file written by rebalance-OS's render_pulse_markdown()/pulse-sync (headed '# Live Pulse — ...' with Today/Yesterday/Upcoming Meetings/Assigned Issues sections) — NOT the raw per-device pulse-<hostname>.md tab-separated commit log, which has no sections. Empty = not configured.
